adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a raw-HTML path that bypasses Discourse’s normal cooking/sanitization: Post#cook now returns `raw` unchanged when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), and TopicEmbed.import creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` and `skip_validations: true` using RSS/remote contents (app/models/topic_embed.rb). The RSS path (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) passes `i.content` through `CGI.unescapeHTML` but does not sanitize/whitelist tags/attributes before storing. The embed view renders with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), so any injected HTML/JS in imported content will execute in the Discourse origin context. This is a verifiable stored XSS risk introduced/exposed by the diff.
